question: How many oTENTik units are there in total?
List the distinct provinces that have oTENTiks.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT province FROM parks ORDER BY province;

question: How many park locations are in Nova Scotia?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parks WHERE province = 'Nova Scotia';

question: How many oTENTik units does Fundy National Park have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM otentiks o JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id WHERE p.park_group = 'Fundy National Park';

question: Which park group has the most oTENTik units? Return the group name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT p.park_group, COUNT(*) AS n FROM otentiks o JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id GROUP BY p.park_group ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many oTENTiks are available on 2026-07-01?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM availability WHERE date = '2026-07-01' AND is_available = 1;

question: Which park groups have at least one oTENTik available on 2026-07-01? List the group names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.park_group FROM availability a JOIN otentiks o ON a.resource_id = o.resource_id JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id WHERE a.date = '2026-07-01' AND a.is_available = 1 ORDER BY p.park_group;

question: For each province, how many oTENTik-nights are available in total across all scanned dates?
gold_sql: SELECT p.province, SUM(a.is_available) AS nights FROM availability a JOIN otentiks o ON a.resource_id = o.resource_id JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id GROUP BY p.province ORDER BY nights DESC;

question: Which oTENTik unit has the most available nights overall? Give the resource name, its park group, and the number of available nights.
gold_sql: SELECT o.resource_name, p.park_group, SUM(a.is_available) AS nights FROM availability a JOIN otentiks o ON a.resource_id = o.resource_id JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id GROUP BY o.resource_id ORDER BY nights DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Count the distinct dates on which at least one oTENTik in Cape Breton Highlands National Park is available.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.date) FROM availability a JOIN otentiks o ON a.resource_id = o.resource_id JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id WHERE p.park_group = 'Cape Breton Highlands National Park' AND a.is_available = 1;

question: List the resource names of all oTENTiks at the Cavendish location.
gold_sql: SELECT o.resource_name FROM otentiks o JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id WHERE p.location = 'Cavendish' ORDER BY o.resource_name;

question: On which date is the largest number of oTENTiks available? Return the date and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT date, SUM(is_available) AS n FROM availability GROUP BY date ORDER BY n DESC, date ASC LIMIT 1;

question: How many oTENTiks in New Brunswick are available on 2026-06-15?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM availability a JOIN otentiks o ON a.resource_id = o.resource_id JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id WHERE p.province = 'New Brunswick' AND a.date = '2026-06-15' AND a.is_available = 1;

question: Which park locations have no availability at all across the entire scan window?
gold_sql: SELECT p.park_name FROM parks p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM availability a JOIN otentiks o ON a.resource_id = o.resource_id WHERE o.park_id = p.park_id AND a.is_available = 1) ORDER BY p.park_name;

question: What is the average number of available oTENTiks per day in June 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(daily) FROM (SELECT date, SUM(is_available) AS daily FROM availability WHERE date >= '2026-06-01' AND date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY date);

question: List each park group together with the number of oTENTik units it has, ordered from most to fewest.
gold_sql: SELECT p.park_group, COUNT(*) AS units FROM otentiks o JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id GROUP BY p.park_group ORDER BY units DESC, p.park_group;

question: Find the earliest date on which any oTENTik in Prince Edward Island National Park is available.
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(a.date) FROM availability a JOIN otentiks o ON a.resource_id = o.resource_id JOIN parks p ON o.park_id = p.park_id WHERE p.park_group = 'Prince Edward Island National Park' AND a.is_available = 1;

question: How many oTENTiks have never been available on any scanned date?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM otentiks o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM availability a WHERE a.resource_id = o.resource_id AND a.is_available = 1);
